approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Reproduce an insulation-thickness value accepted as pipe diameter inside one exact RFI citation.
Bind a bounded set of explicit measurement roles to their mutually nearest numeric value and exact workflow identity.
Preserve common dimensional pipe and insulation wording without building a general engineering ontology.
Make no provider request, dependency, unit conversion, arithmetic or source-authority rule.
title: Ground numeric measurement properties
objective: Prevent a numeric value from moving between explicit measurement properties within one RFI, Submittal, Email or Specification answer scope.
